summary: Frontend-only verification of the 'Paste text' upload bug fix on My Notes page. English paste (chapter='English Chapter Test'), Hindi paste (chapter='हिंदी अध्याय', body='यह एक छोटा हिंदी नोट है।...'), and .txt file regression upload all returned HTTP 200 on POST /api/notes/upload, showed 'Note added!' toast, and appeared in the notes-list. Content-Type header sent by axios was 'multipart/form-data; boundary=----WebKitFormBoundary...' context_for_next_testing_agent: Bug from user report (Paste Text -> 'Upload failed' toast for short EN/HI text) is fully resolved. Root cause was Notes.jsx sending a manual Content-Type: multipart/form-data header without a boundary, so FastAPI's Form() parser returned 422 which surfaced as 'Upload failed'. Fix (letting axios/browser set the header automatically) verified end-to-end via real preview URL. If retesting: register fresh user, login, click nav-notes, tab-text, fill chapter-input + text-input, click upload-submit, expect toast 'Note added!' and new note in notes-list.
rca of the issue: RCA: In Notes.jsx submit() the previous version passed { headers: { 'Content-Type': 'multipart/form-data' } } to api.post. When you set that header manually, the browser/axios does NOT append the '; boundary=...' parameter, so FastAPI cannot parse the multipart body and rejects the 'chapter'/'text' form fields (422), which the UI displays as 'Upload failed'. Reproduction (pre-fix): tab-text, chapter='X', text='hi' -> submit -> toast 'Upload failed'. Mitigation applied by main agent: remove the explicit Content-Type header so axios lets the browser generate the correct 'multipart/form-data; boundary=----WebKitFormBoundary...' header. Verified this iteration with EN + HI short paste and .txt file upload all returning 200.
